prompts.wet_stone: Create a production texture asset for Undertow, the painted isometric Godot game whose local approved concept art was just shown (port-city/10-isometric-city-block.png and 04-hillside-houses.png). Match their richly painted, natural damp materials and visible brushwork, rather than photographic grit or procedural flat color. This is an unlit base material: cool neutral blue-grey and subdued teal, no gold, amber, orange, cyan glow, lighting pools, magical motifs, text, objects, border, grid labels, perspective, or vignette. Orthographic straight-on square full-bleed seamless material texture, 1024x1024. Uniform soft diffuse light; matching opposite edges. Small-scale detail should remain readable when mapped to a 128x72 isometric tile. Subject: wet old stone cobblestones, about 5 by 5 irregular rounded rectangular hand-set stones across the image, dark graphite-blue stone with lighter worn edges, thin moss in deep narrow mortar, subtle wet sheen without reflections of lamps. Close packed cobbles, coherent repeating stonework.

prompts.operator_poses: Use the locally shown port-city/12-character-lineup.png as the design reference for the Operator, the stocky maintenance worker at left, and port-city/10-isometric-city-block.png for gameplay viewing angle. Generate ONE transparent 2-frame sprite sheet, 1024x1024 square. Left half contains a full-body three-quarter FRONT view facing screen-right/down; right half contains the EXACT SAME worker in three-quarter REAR view facing screen-right/up. Both are viewed from a fixed isometric game camera elevated about 35 degrees, showing cap top and shoulders, with identical body proportions and identical scale. Each whole figure fully fits in its half, head near y=120, boot soles aligned y=900, empty margins and a wide clear transparent gap at x=512. Stocky older municipal worker, dark navy worn coveralls, matching cap, dark work boots, tool belt, stitched pockets, dull grey-ivory worn hi-vis chevrons on chest and small dull grey bands on calves. Hand-painted, dense restrained brushwork, strong readable silhouette and soft neutral cool daylight. Idle relaxed pose, empty gloved hands, no weapon. One small unlit earpiece near head; no glowing gold details, no ring, no backpack, no gold/yellow/orange light. Faces remain in shadow with no detailed expression. Completely transparent background, no ground, shadow, labels, text, scenery, borders or guide marks. These are real runtime character sprites, not a concept board.
